PRINCIPLE: Assertions should be specific and include messages when helpful. EVALUATION: There are zero assertions in the test; thus assertions are inadequate. DECISION: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Comments should explain why, not what; avoid commented-out code. EVALUATION: The snippet contains no commented-out test code and minimal comments (a marker interface Javadoc) and no excessive inline comments. DECISION: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must avoid non-deterministic sources. EVALUATION: The test instantiates an object and contains no randomness, time-based calls, Thread.sleep or external dependencies in the visible code. DECISION: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should not modify shared state. EVALUATION: The test uses only a local variable and does not create files, DB entries, or modify static state in the visible snippet. DECISION: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Use labels/categories to classify tests. EVALUATION: The class is annotated with @Category(UnitTest.class), providing meaningful classification. DECISION: compliant.
